elements.name: Snowshoes
elements.desc: Snowshoes reduce the likelihood of their wearer getting stuck in the deep snow. Worn on the feet.

elements.name: The Incantations of Iriolarthas
elements.desc:
The Incantations of Iriolarthas is a weighty spellbook. Its black leather covers have dead, toothy worms glued to them, sheathed in glossy varnish. Set into this morbid display on the front cover is a gold rune that resembles a stylized eye with a pupil shaped like a candle flame — the sigil of Iriolarthas, a Netherese lich.

The book contains sixty pages of brittle yellow vellum. Written on these pages are the following wizard spells:

1st level: alarm, detect magic, identify, magic missile, shield, Tasha's hideous laughter, thunderwave

2nd level: arcane lock, continual flame, invisibility, knock, levitate, Melf's acid arrow, mirror image

3rd level: animate dead, bestow curse, clairvoyance, counterspell, dispel magic, fireball, glyph of warding

4th level: arcane eye, banishment, blight, dimension door, Evard's black tentacles, phantasmal killer

5th level: Bigby's hand, cloudkill, dominate person, planar binding, scrying, telekinesis

6th level: create undead, disintegrate, globe of invulnerability, move earth, Otto's irresistible dance

7th level: create magen, finger of death, prismatic spray, teleport

8th level: demiplane, dominate monster, mind blank, power word stun

9th level: blade of disaster, power word kill

elements.name: Crampons
elements.desc: A crampon is a metal plate with spikes that is strapped to the sole of a boot. A creature wearing crampons can't fall prone while moving across slippery ice.

elements.name: Clothing, Cold Weather
elements.desc:
This outfit consists of a heavy fur coat or cloak over layers of wool clothing, as well as a fur-lined hat or hood, goggles, and fur-lined leather boots and gloves.

As long as cold weather clothing remains dry, its wearer automatically succeeds on saving throws against the effects of extreme cold.

elements.name: Dogsled
elements.desc: An empty sled costs 20 gp, weighs 300 pounds, and has room at the back for one driver.

elements.name: Sled Dog
elements.desc:
A sled dog (use the wolf stat block in appendix A of the Monster Manual) costs 50 gp and can pull 360 pounds.

Sled dogs must take a short rest after pulling a sled for 1 hour; otherwise, they gain one level of exhaustion.

Speed. 40 ft.

elements.name: Axe Beak
elements.desc:
An axe beak's splayed toes allow it to run across snow, and it can carry as much weight as a mule. A domesticated axe beak can be purchased in Ten-Towns for 50 gp.

Speed. 40 ft.

Carrying Capacity. 420 lb.

elements.name: Spider-Shaped Brooch
elements.desc: A spider-shaped brooch made of obsidian and engraved with the symbol of House Dalambra. Worth 25 gp.

elements.name: Harp of Exotic Wood
elements.desc: A carved harp of exotic wood with ivory inlay and zircon gemstones. Worth 750 gp.

elements.name: Decorative Pearl Bead
elements.desc: A pearl carved into a decorative bead. Worth 5 gp.

elements.name: Electrum Pendant
elements.desc: An electrum chain with a bloodstone pendant. Worth 250 gp.

elements.name: Gold Whirlpool Ring
elements.desc: A gold ring with a black pearl set into a fixture shaped like a whirlpool. Worth 750 gp.

elements.name: Mummy's Golden Mask
elements.desc: This mummy's golden mask is a Netherese art object. Worth 750 gp.

elements.name: Silk Robe
elements.desc: A silk robe spun by the spiders. Worth 250 gp.

elements.name: Undamaged Remorhaz Egg
elements.desc: An undamaged remorhaz egg can be sold to an interested buyer in Bryn Shander for up to 500 gp.

elements.name: Vial of Quicksilver
elements.desc: A vial of quicksilver. Worth 500 gp.

elements.name: Intricate Crystal Rod
elements.desc: An intricate crystal rod. Worth 1,800 gp.

elements.name: Miniature Netherese Skycoach
elements.desc: A miniature Netherese skycoach in a bottle. Worth 750 gp.
